content:
Post 1

CSL surged 17.25% to AUD 157.82 — yet the ASX 200 barely moved, closing down 3.20pts at 9,070. One stock nearly saved the whole index. Strip CSL out and Tuesday was ugly. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

📈 Health Care exploded +7.81% — CSL did the heavy lifting. Everything else largely bled: Financials -1.10%, Consumer Staples -1.16%, Telcos -1.27%. Breadth was poor behind a glamorous headline. #ASX #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 3

🔻 Sims Limited dropped 11.04% to AUD 22.97 — the session's sharpest fall. Scrap metal demand concerns are real and the market isn't waiting for confirmation. Watch Materials closely. #ASX #materials #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,207.28/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7095. A firmer Aussie dollar caps gold upside in local terms. Silver AUD 92.44/oz. Metals holding but currency is the swing factor. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

ASX sits 2.44% below its 52-week high after a -1.95% five-day skid. Can CSL's result carry the index back toward that peak, or does weak breadth win? What's your read — rebound or retest? #ASX #ausbiz
